prerequisites.label: Current PR head has green CI
Apply to one agent before fleet rollout
Collect sanitized event counts and errors only
prerequisites.evidence: no raw memories, transcripts, keys, or local paths

steps.label: Pull or install the approved commit
Observe one active session before wider rollout
steps.command: collect sanitized counts from trace and monitor outputs

steps.label: Rollback if lifecycle writes, recall, or privacy checks fail
steps.command: restore the pre-update adapter backup and disable the selfmem provider

passCriteria: error_count equals 0 for the canary window
before_prompt_build recall appears in at least one real turn
agent_end or sync_turn writes produce distilled local memory
p95 recall latency remains acceptable for the host
rollback path is documented before wider rollout
caveats: This dashboard is fixture-only and does not touch a real agent.
A canary pass is not public launch approval.
Hosted Supermemory remains read-through only unless a later approved policy changes it.
